present.label: Read the input
present.story: {n} days of visitor counts. We want the busiest stretch of {k} consecutive days.
present.formal: visitors has {n} values. Find the largest sum over all subarrays of length k = {k}.

initialize.label: Start the window
initialize.story: Start with an empty window and a running total of 0.

add-initial.label: Build the first window
add-initial.formal: window_sum += visitors[{index}] → {windowSum}. Values still to add for the first window: {remaining}.

record-first.label: Record the first total
record-first.story: Days 0 to {end} had {total} visitors. It is the best so far, simply because it is the first.

slide.label: Slide one day
slide.formal: window_sum += visitors[{enterIndex}] − visitors[{leaveIndex}]: {before} → {after}. The window is now [{start}, {end}].

new-best.label: New best
new-best.story: {total} beats the old best of {previousBest}. The busiest stretch now starts on day {start}.

keep-best:lower.label: Keep the best
keep-best:lower.story: {total} is fewer than the best of {best}, so the stretch starting on day {bestStart} stays the busiest.

keep-best:tie.label: Tie: keep the earlier
keep-best:tie.story: {total} ties the best. The rules say the earlier stretch wins, so day {bestStart} stays.
keep-best:tie.formal: {total} = best. The strict > keeps the earliest best_start = {bestStart}.

done.label: Return the answer
done.story: The busiest stretch runs from day {start} to day {end}, with {total} visitors.

present.label: Read the input
present.story: {n} days of visitor counts. First write running totals, then read every {k}-day stretch from them.
present.formal: Build P with P[0] = 0 and P[i + 1] = P[i] + visitors[i]. Then the sum of a..a+k−1 is P[a + k] − P[a].

initialize.label: Start the totals
initialize.story: Before any day, the running total is 0.

build-prefix.label: Write a running total
build-prefix.story: Day {day} adds {value}: {before} + {value} = {after} visitors over the first {position} days.

range-sum.label: Read a stretch
range-sum.story: Days {start} to {end}: the total after day {end} minus the total before day {start} is {endPrefix} − {startPrefix} = {total}.

new-best:first.label: Record the first total
new-best:first.story: {total} is the first stretch total, so it is the best so far.

new-best:better.label: New best
new-best:better.story: {total} beats the old best of {previousBest}. The busiest stretch now starts on day {start}.

keep-best:lower.label: Keep the best
keep-best:lower.story: {total} is fewer than the best of {best}, so the stretch starting on day {bestStart} stays the busiest.

keep-best:tie.label: Tie: keep the earlier
keep-best:tie.story: {total} ties the best. The rules say the earlier stretch wins, so day {bestStart} stays.
keep-best:tie.formal: {total} = best. The strict > keeps the earliest best_start = {bestStart}.

done.label: Return the answer
done.story: The busiest stretch runs from day {start} to day {end}, with {total} visitors.
